# Cookie Guardian

> Chrome extension that automatically deletes cookies when you close a tab. Privacy protection without the hassle.

## What It Is
Cookie Guardian is a browser extension that auto-deletes cookies on tab close. It is the only Manifest V3 auto-delete cookie extension on the Chrome Web Store, serving as the modern replacement for Cookie AutoDelete (which was removed due to MV2 deprecation).

## Key Stats
- 2,800+ active users
- 37 reviews
- Featured badge on Chrome Web Store
- Free core functionality, $3.49 one-time premium upgrade

## Browser Support
- Google Chrome
- Brave
- Microsoft Edge
- Opera
- Vivaldi

## Privacy
- Zero data collection
- All data stored locally on the user's device
- No analytics, no telemetry, no remote servers

## Core Features
- Automatic cookie deletion on tab close
- Whitelisting for trusted sites
- Domain-level and subdomain control
- Cookie activity notifications
- Import/export settings
- Premium: advanced rules, priority support
